title: Status workflow transitions
description: Add a PATCH endpoint for status transitions (open -> in-progress -> resolved -> closed) with validation. Add status transition buttons to the bug detail view that update immediately.
designContext: PATCH /api/v1/bugs/:id/status accepts { status } body. Valid transitions: open->in-progress, in-progress->resolved, resolved->closed. Invalid transitions return 400. Detail view shows contextual transition buttons based on current status.
